_comment: The promises of `import.defer()` resolve while `pause.js` waits at its top-level await, before the code of `d.js`, `dep.js` and `data.json` in the chunk. A read in a callback evaluates `d.js`, which reads the namespace object of `dep.js`, and reads the data of `data.json`. The chunk puts the declarations of each module of the deferred closures first.
